concept: A1 Event - Serving becomes better than threshold
purpose: Triggers when serving cell quality exceeds threshold, used to stop inter-frequency measurements or deactivate secondary carriers to save UE power
trigger_conditions: Where Ms = serving cell measurement, Hys = hysteresis, Thresh = a1-Threshold
kpi_patterns: Strong RSRP > threshold indicates good serving cell coverage
Stable RSRP above threshold reduces unnecessary measurements
failure_symptoms: Unnecessary inter-frequency measurements consuming UE battery
Failure to stop measurements when serving is strong
possible_root_causes: Hysteresis too large causing delayed entry
recommended_actions: Set a1-Threshold to -100 to -90 dBm RSRP for typical macro
Use hysteresis 1-3 dB for stability
Verify measurement object linked to correct carriers

concept: A2 Event - Serving becomes worse than threshold
purpose: Triggers when serving cell quality degrades below threshold, used to start inter-frequency measurements or activate CA/DC
trigger_conditions: Where Ms = serving cell measurement, Thresh = a2-Threshold
kpi_patterns: RSRP dropping below -110 dBm indicates coverage degradation
RSRQ below -12 dB with weak RSRP suggests cell edge
Throughput degradation correlating with A2 triggers
failure_symptoms: Missed handover opportunities to better carriers
Coverage holes not detected in time
recommended_actions: Set a2-Threshold to -110 to -105 dBm RSRP
Reduce hysteresis if late triggering observed
Ensure inter-frequency measurement objects configured

concept: A3 Event - Neighbor becomes offset better than SpCell
purpose: Primary intra-frequency handover trigger when neighboring cell becomes stronger than serving cell by configured offset
trigger_conditions: Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off (entering)
Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off (leaving)
Where Mn = neighbor measurement, Mp = SpCell measurement, Off = a3-Offset
kpi_patterns: Low handover success rate with weak serving RSRP indicates late HO
Ping-pong handovers with fluctuating RSRP between cells
High HO success but frequent HOs indicates low offset/hysteresis
possible_root_causes: a3-Offset misconfigured (too high causes late HO, too low causes ping-pong)
timeToTrigger too long or too short
recommended_actions: Set a3-Offset to 2-6 dB (start with 3 dB)
Configure hysteresis 1-2 dB for macro cells
Set timeToTrigger 100-320 ms for macro, 40-80 ms for small cells
Enable cell individual offset for problematic cell pairs
Review antenna tilt/azimuth for coverage overlap issues

concept: A4 Event - Neighbor becomes better than threshold
purpose: Triggers when neighbor cell exceeds absolute threshold, used for inter-frequency handover preparation or CA activation
trigger_conditions: Where Mn = neighbor measurement, Thresh = a4-Threshold
kpi_patterns: Strong neighbor RSRP above threshold indicates HO candidate available
Multiple neighbors above threshold may indicate coverage overlap
failure_symptoms: Inter-frequency HO not triggered despite strong neighbor
CA SCell not activated when neighbor is strong
recommended_actions: Set a4-Threshold based on inter-frequency HO policy
Verify neighbor cells in measurement object
Review ANR configuration for automatic neighbor detection

concept: A5 Event - SpCell worse than threshold1 AND neighbor better than threshold2
purpose: Coverage-based inter-frequency handover trigger requiring both serving degradation and target availability
trigger_conditions: Mp + Hys < Thresh1 AND Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Thresh2 (entering)
Mp - Hys > Thresh1 OR Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Thresh2 (leaving)
Where Mp = SpCell, Mn = neighbor, Thresh1 = a5-Threshold1, Thresh2 = a5-Threshold2
kpi_patterns: Low serving RSRP below Thresh1 combined with strong neighbor above Thresh2
Inter-frequency HO success correlating with A5 threshold settings
Coverage-triggered HO patterns at cell boundaries
failure_symptoms: Inter-frequency handover not triggered at cell edge
Unnecessary inter-frequency HO when serving is adequate
possible_root_causes: a5-Threshold2 set too high (no suitable target found)
recommended_actions: Set a5-Threshold1 to -110 to -115 dBm (serving degradation trigger)
Set a5-Threshold2 to -110 to -100 dBm (target quality requirement)
Ensure measurement gaps configured for inter-frequency measurements
Verify inter-frequency neighbor relations complete

concept: A6 Event - Neighbor becomes offset better than SCell
purpose: Secondary Cell change trigger in Carrier Aggregation when neighbor SCell becomes better than current SCell
trigger_conditions: Mn + Ocn - Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off (entering)
Mn + Ocn + Hys < Ms + Ocs + Off (leaving)
Where Mn = neighbor SCell, Ms = current SCell, Off = a6-Offset
kpi_patterns: SCell RSRP variation indicating mobility through CA coverage
Throughput improvement after SCell change
failure_symptoms: SCell not changed despite better neighbor available
recommended_actions: Configure a6-Offset 2-4 dB for SCell stability
Enable SCell measurements
Verify SCell neighbor list completeness

concept: T310 Timer - Radio Link Problem Detection
purpose: Timer started upon receiving N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications from physical layer, leading to RLF declaration upon expiry
trigger_conditions: N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications received from L1
Out-of-sync based on BLER threshold (Qout) exceeded
Physical layer indicates radio link quality below threshold
kpi_patterns: High BLER (>10%) preceding T310 start
Low SINR (<0 dB) correlating with out-of-sync indications
RSRP degradation trend before T310 expiry
Consecutive poor radio conditions triggering N310
possible_root_causes: Strong interference (low SINR despite adequate RSRP)
T310 value too short for transient conditions
recommended_actions: Analyze RLF reports for T310 expiry patterns
Increase T310 (50-2000ms) if transient conditions cause false RLF
Increase N310 (1-20) to reduce sensitivity to brief outages
Address coverage or interference root cause
Optimize handover parameters to trigger HO before T310 expiry

purpose: Counts consecutive out-of-sync indications from physical layer before starting T310 timer
trigger_conditions: Physical layer indicates out-of-sync (BLER > Qout threshold)
Counter increments on each consecutive out-of-sync
T310 starts when counter reaches N310 value
kpi_patterns: Sustained high BLER leading to N310 threshold reached
Intermittent poor quality not reaching N310 (filtering effect)
operational_impact: Balance between false RLF and detection delay
recommended_actions: Set N310 1-5 for quick detection in stable environments
Set N310 5-10 for environments with transient interference
Analyze correlation between N310 settings and RLF rates

purpose: Counts consecutive in-sync indications to stop T310 timer and recover from radio link problem
trigger_conditions: Physical layer indicates in-sync (BLER < Qin threshold)
Counter increments on each consecutive in-sync
T310 stopped when counter reaches N311 value
kpi_patterns: BLER recovery below Qin threshold
SINR improvement leading to in-sync indications
failure_symptoms: T310 not stopped despite improved conditions (N311 too high)
Premature recovery leading to subsequent RLF (N311 too low)
possible_root_causes: Unstable RF conditions preventing sustained in-sync
operational_impact: Ability to recover from transient degradation
recommended_actions: Set N311 1-3 for quick recovery
Ensure N311 provides stability before stopping T310
Coordinate N310/N311 values for balanced RLF behavior

purpose: Timer for RRC connection re-establishment procedure after RLF, handover failure, or other failures
trigger_conditions: RLF declared (T310 expiry, RLC max retransmissions, etc.)
kpi_patterns: Re-establishment success correlating with T311 duration
Coverage availability during T311 period
possible_root_causes: No suitable cell found within T311 duration
T311 too short for cell selection
operational_impact: Service continuity depends on successful re-establishment
User returns to IDLE if re-establishment fails
recommended_actions: Set T311 1000-3000 ms for typical macro deployments
Increase T311 if frequent expirations observed
Ensure adequate coverage for re-establishment
Verify UE context stored at potential re-establishment cells

purpose: Timer for handover execution from reconfigurationWithSync application to successful random access completion on target cell

possible_root_causes: T304 value too short for RACH procedure
recommended_actions: Set T304 100-200 ms for normal conditions
Increase T304 to 500+ ms for challenging RF or loaded cells
Configure dedicated preambles for handover
Optimize RACH parameters on target cells
Ensure adequate target cell coverage at HO execution point

purpose: Declaration of radio link failure when UE loses reliable communication with serving cell, triggering re-establishment

Tune T310/N310/N311 for appropriate RLF sensitivity
